card.name: Service providers about to act for you
card.fires_on: Small words (quote mark, to, we, can, not, just) right before a verb of a professional or business providing a service, such as serving, providing, fixing or calling for help. Seen in clinic, vet, dental and shop settings.

modes.label: Provider offering service
modes.description: A clinic or business says what it will do for the customer, just before the service verb.
modes.example: We will be pleased<< to>> provide your examination, consultation and answer all

modes.label: Staff about to act
modes.description: A professional or tradesperson is the subject, and the next word is an action done for someone.
modes.example: if you go into the dealer with a problem they<< just>> fix it for free, long after the

modes.label: Refusal or call for help
modes.description: A word just before a service is given or refused, or before a call is made.
modes.example: told the barbers could<< not>> serve her because of their religion.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about sleeping, watching and being at home, and away from hiring and selling words.
card.plain: It lights up on small words just before someone like a clinic, vet or repairer does a job for a customer.
